Web Weaver brings a sense of craft and intentionality to the retro-web aesthetic, wrapping portfolio content in a dark interface built from connected panels and recurring circular motifs. The overall effect is of a site that has been woven rather than assembled — structured, deliberate, and quietly expressive.

## Theme Overview

Web Weaver positions the developer as a craftsperson — someone who builds the web with the same care a weaver brings to fabric. Its dark background anchors a layout of interconnected content panels whose visual threading evokes structure and cohesion. Circular motifs appear throughout as design elements that echo the idea of loops, connections, and the interlocking nature of well-built systems. The typography is precise and readable against the dark ground, keeping the focus on content while the layout does quiet expressive work.

## Design Highlights

- Dark background with a carefully structured panel layout that feels interconnected
- Circular motifs used as recurring visual elements throughout the interface
- Connected-panel design that communicates craftsmanship and architectural thinking
- Precise, readable typography tuned for dark-mode contrast and legibility
- A cohesive visual language that reinforces a "woven together" sense of design intent

## Who This Theme Suits

Web Weaver suits developers and engineers who want their portfolio to communicate both technical precision and creative thoughtfulness. It works particularly well for full-stack developers, systems engineers, or anyone whose professional identity involves building things that are as carefully considered structurally as they are visually — people who think in systems and want their portfolio to show it.

<Note>
  Web Weaver's dark palette and connected panel structure are well-suited to showcasing technical projects where architecture and design decisions matter as much as the final result.
</Note>
